signatures.0402: **Silver Tongue.** Your innate magic allows you to twist how your words are perceived to get a better read on people and convince them to see things your way. You have one skill of your choice from the interpersonal skill group (see Skills in Chapter 9: Tests), and you gain an edge on tests when attempting to discover an NPC's motivations and pitfalls during a negotiation (see Chapter 11: Negotiation).
signatures.0403: **Wyrmplate.** Your hardened scales grant you damage immunity equal to your level to one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison. You can change your damage immunity type when you finish a respite.
signatures.0404:
**Runic Carving.** You can carve a rune onto your skin with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work, which is activated by the magic within your body. The rune you carve determines the benefit you receive, chosen from among the following:

**Detection:** Pick a specific type of creature (such as goblins or humans) or object (such as gems or potions). Your rune glows softly when you are within 20 squares of any creature or object of that type, even if you don't have line of effect to the creature or object. You can change the type of creature or object as a maneuver.

**Light:** Your skin sheds light for 10 squares. You can turn this light on and off as a maneuver.

**Voice:** As a maneuver, you can communicate telepathically with a willing creature you have met before and who is within 1 mile of you. You must know the creature's name, and they must speak and understand a language you know. You and the creature can respond to one another as if having a spoken conversation. You can communicate with a different creature by changing the rune.

You can have one rune active at a time, and can change or remove a rune with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work.
signatures.0405: **Wode Elf Glamor.** You can magically alter your appearance to better blend in with your surroundings. You gain an edge on tests made to hide and sneak, and tests made to search for you while you are hidden take a bane.
signatures.0406: **High Elf Glamor.** A magic glamor makes others perceive you as interesting and engaging, granting you an edge on Presence tests using the Flirt or Persuade skills. This glamor makes you appear and sound slightly different to each creature you meet, since what is engaging to one might be different for another. However, you never appear to be anyone other than yourself.
signatures.0407: **Big!.** Your stature reflects your giant forebears. Your size is 1L.
signatures.0408: **Detect the Supernatural.** As a maneuver, you can open your awareness to detect supernatural creatures and phenomena. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, or any undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don't have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you're detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.
signatures.0409:
**Fall Lightly.** Your silicone body is low in density. Whenever you fall, you reduce the distance of the fall by 2 squares.

**Lightweight.** Your body is light for a creature of your height. Whenever another creature attempts to force move you, you treat your size as one size smaller than it is.
signatures.0410: **Relentless.** Whenever a creature deals damage to you that leaves you dying, you can make a free strike against any creature. If the creature is reduced to 0 Stamina by your strike, you can spend a Recovery.
signatures.0411:
**Shadowmeld.** You have the following ability.

### Shadowmeld

*You become an actual shadow.*

| **Magic**   |    **Maneuver** |
|-------------|----------------:|
| **📏 Self** |     **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You flatten yourself into a shadow against a wall or floor you are touching, and become hidden from any creature you have cover or concealment from or who isn't observing you. While in shadow form, you have full awareness of your surroundings, and strikes made against you and tests made to search for you take a bane. You can't move or be force moved, and you can't take main actions or maneuvers except to exit this form or to direct creatures under your control, such as one you summon using an ability. Any ability or effect that targets more than 1 square affects you in this form only if it explicitly affects the surface you are flattened against. You can exit this form as a maneuver.

If the surface you are flattened against is destroyed, this ability ends and you take 1d6 damage that can't be reduced in any way.

**Small!.** Your diminutive stature lets you easily get out of—or into—trouble. Your size is 1S.
signatures.0412:
**Former Life.** Choose the ancestry you were before you died. Your size is that ancestry's size and your speed is 5. Unless you select one of the Previous Life traits (see below), you don't receive any other ancestral traits from your original ancestry.

**Tough But Withered.** Your undead body grants you immunity to cold, corruption, lightning, and poison damage equal to your level, but you have fire weakness 5. You can't suffocate, and you don't need to eat or drink to stay alive.

Additionally, when your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value, you become inert instead of dying. You fall prone and can't stand. You continue to observe your surroundings, but you can't speak, take main actions, maneuvers, move actions, or triggered actions. While inert this way, if you take any fire damage, your body is destroyed and you die. Otherwise, after 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.
signatures.0413: **Psychic Scar.** Your mind is a formidable layer of defense. You have psychic immunity equal to your level.
signatures.0414:
**Call of the Horizon.** You are a gifted navigator. You have one additional skill from the exploration skill group (see [Skills](#/codex/1208)).

**Beast Still Within.** The beast still stirs within you, and its anger makes you stronger. When you force move a creature or object, the distance of that forced movement gains a +1 bonus.
signatures.0415: **Instinctive Agility.** You have learned to survive in a world that sees you as prey. When a creature is about to make a strike against you, you can use a triggered action to shift up to 2 squares. You also have one additional skill from the intrigue skill group (see [Skills](#/codex/1208)).

translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros:
Created for the Last Myth campaign, tauros, also called minotaurs, descend from demons who emerged during the Infernal Breach. Their ancestors retained their minds despite the rage and thirst for destruction that consumed the others.

Their humanoid shape does little to disguise their heritage. They stand taller than most other ancestries and have a bull’s features. Some are born with cloven hooves and tails. Each bears a pair of weathered horns, a source of pride for every minotaur.

As the Twilight War waned, the tauros scattered across the Expanse, drawn to the hunt and to the distant horizon. Their communities are mostly tribal, and they rarely settle in one place for long.

## Tauros Traits

Minotaur heroes have access to the following physiological benefits.
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.signature.call-of-the-ho: **Signature trait.** You are a gifted navigator. You have one additional skill from the exploration skill group (see [Skills](#/codex/1208)).
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.signature.beast-still-wi: **Signature trait.** The beast still stirs within you, and its anger makes you stronger. When you force move a creature or object, the distance of that forced movement gains a +1 bonus.
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.piercing-horns: **1 point.** Your horns are sharp as well as imposing. Once per round when you make a melee strike, you can deal extra damage with the strike equal to your highest characteristic score.
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.beast-legs: **1 point.** Your powerful legs make you noticeably faster. Your speed is 6.
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.grounded: **1 point.** You move when you choose to. You gain a +1 bonus to stability.
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.undeterred: **1 point.** You shrug off feeble attacks. Your Might score is considered 1 higher for resisting potencies. You gain an edge on Might tests to resist environmental effects or a creature’s features or abilities.
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.let-loose:
**2 points.** You gain the following signature ability.

*With a furious roar, you let the beast loose.*

**Area, Melee · Main action**

**Distance:** 1 burst · **Target:** Each enemy in the area

**Power Roll + Might or Presence:**
- **≤11:** 2 damage
- **12–16:** 5 damage; push 1
- **17+:** 7 damage; push 2
translatedTraits.ancestry.tauros.beast-regeneration: **2 points.** Your wounds close with unnatural speed. If you are winded at the start of your turn, you regain Stamina equal to your echelon.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk:
Created for the Last Myth campaign, lizardfolk are small, dragonlike creatures. They descend from the great true dragons the gods wiped out in an ancient war.

Few see those mythical creatures in a lizardfolk’s slight frame. Yet they share their ancestors’ scales, long snouts and heavy tails, and some are born with wings. Even so, few people take them seriously.

Over generations, lizardfolk have learned to turn this to their advantage. They are known for cunning and agility, though those traits hardly define them. Lizardfolk know their worth and always find a way to survive in a world that mocks them.

## Lizardfolk Traits

Lizardfolk heroes have access to the following physiological benefits.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.signature.instinctiv: **Signature trait.** You have learned to survive in a world that sees you as prey. When a creature is about to make a strike against you, you can use a triggered action to shift up to 2 squares. You also have one additional skill from the intrigue skill group (see [Skills](#/codex/1208)).
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.reactive-movement: **1 point.** Your light step lets you change position quickly. When you are force moved, you can use a free triggered action to shift 1 square after the forced movement ends.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.wings: **2 points.** You have wings strong enough to lift you into the air. When you fly using your wings, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might score (minimum 1 round) before you fall. While flying this way at level 3 or lower, you have damage weakness 5.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.dragon-heritage:
**2 points.** You gain the following signature ability.

*A furious breath of energy washes over your foes.*

**Area, Magic · Main action**

**Distance:** 3 cube within 1 · **Target:** Each enemy in the area

**Power Roll + Might or Presence:**
- **≤11:** 2 damage
- **12–16:** 4 damage
- **17+:** 6 damage

**Effect:** Choose the ability’s damage type from acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning or poison.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.barbed-tail: **1 point.** Your barbed tail lets you punctuate your actions. Once per round when you make a melee strike, you can deal extra damage with the strike equal to your highest characteristic score.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.slippery-scales: **1 point.** Your scales make you hard to hold. You have the Escape Artist skill from the intrigue skill group, and enemies take a bane on attempts to grab you.
translatedTraits.ancestry.lizardfolk.hit-the-liver: **1 point.** Your ability rolls gain an edge against a creature adjacent to at least one of your allies who is not a minion. You do not gain another edge for flanking that creature with the same ally.
